overview: This enum selects the mouth pose used by character animation and lip sync.

None.technical: The header defines None as the zero value. Table row constructors default MouthType to None. The lip sync loader appends MouthTypeArray and removes None entries before cycling poses. The facial controller returns without changing the mouth montage when it receives None.

Close_01.technical: The facial controller maps Close_01 to the Mouth_Close_01 animation name and plays it on the mouth animation instance. The sequencer mouth module resolves the same byte through AGameCharacter::GetFacialPartsMouthAnimationName before creating a montage on MouthSlot.

Open_01.simple: The character opens their mouth with the first open pose.
Open_01.technical: The facial controller maps Open_01 to the Mouth_Open_01 animation name and plays it on the mouth animation instance. The sequencer mouth module resolves the same byte through AGameCharacter::GetFacialPartsMouthAnimationName before creating a montage on MouthSlot.

Open_02.simple: The character opens their mouth with the second open pose.
Open_02.technical: The facial controller maps Open_02 to the Mouth_Open_02 animation name and plays it on the mouth animation instance. The sequencer mouth module resolves the same byte through AGameCharacter::GetFacialPartsMouthAnimationName before creating a montage on MouthSlot.

Invalid.simple: The current mouth pose is cleared.
Invalid.technical: The header defines Invalid as the explicit 255 sentinel. The converter evaluator requests Invalid to stop the mouth facial animation. The facial controller stops the MouthGroup montage with zero blend time for Invalid. The mouth sequencer module treats 255 as its ignored facial type and stops the MouthSlot montage.

notes: MouthTypeArray values are cycled after None entries are removed, and the index wraps modulo the filtered count.
The MouthType field on CharacterMouthAnim rows has no traced read in the unique pair evaluator, so it does not define the cycled poses there.
No aliases or unused numeric slots appear between None and Invalid.
